summary: "If you want to build a ship, don’t drum up the men to gather wood, divide the work, and give orders. Instead, teach them to yearn for the vast and endless sea." ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY h/t @iamjessklein for best quote on learning in awhile
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
"If you want to build a ship, don’t drum up the men to gather wood, divide the work, and give orders. Instead, teach them to yearn for the vast and endless sea."
ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY
h/t @iamjessklein for best quote on learning in awhile
